18:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: NBA Basketball
The 76ers host the Heat in NBA play at Xfinity Mobile Arena. First in the Eastern Conference at 14-4, Philadelphia welcome a Miami side that has won seven straight and sits sixth in the East at 10-6.

20:35 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NBA Basketball
The Thunder host the Timberwolves in NBA Western Conference play at Paycom Center. Oklahoma City sit tenth in the West at 10-8 after losing four of their last five, while Minnesota arrive third at 13-5 and winners of four of five.
